subject: Correct error from input$CHECKBOX that is dynamically/reactively displayed

messages.author: 8483ab0cfd573506
messages.subject: Correct error from input$CHECKBOX that is dynamically/reactively displayed
parts:
Hi all,

I've created an app which, in general, works pretty well.
https://nzcoops.shinyapps.io/ingress_as3
It's basically to do some tabling and graphing of stats from a mobile game (so you have to have a login to a particular website to source the data).
A data file you can upload is attached to this, as is the server and ui code.

I think the code is fairly logical (clear to follow), you'll see a lot of 'is.null(input$file1)' which I got from a gallery example so things don't appear until the file is uploaded.
I probably could have tried to use less 'if' statements :/

My question: How do I correct the error below?

Error in if (!is.null(input$file1) && input$newvar == TRUE) { :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Seems to me it is trying to resolve that before the checkbox 'input$newvar' is created.
I have seen the thread about suppressing the red error messages, but I my questions is specifically around circumventing this error rather than hiding the display of it's message.

I had a play with 'validate', I may not have put it in the right place?

Thanks
Matt
